fluid.xenon_materials.molten_verdant_ste: Useful both for you and your target to maximize gained experience.

Grants +0.15 accuracy in biomes with neutral temperatures

Grants +0.1 power per level per health above 14

modifier.xenon_materials.frigid.descript: Projectile deals more damage to fire-based creatures

Has a 50% chance when hit (or 100% chance if blocking) to poison the attacker for 5 seconds

modifier.xenon_materials.earth_eater.fla: Would you still love me if I was a worm?

modifier.xenon_materials.sporeshot.flavo: The power of the mighty mushroom!

modifier.xenon_materials.sporeburst.flav: The power of the mighty mushroom!
modifier.xenon_materials.sporeburst.desc: Has a chance to poison attackers

__comment: Ferroshroom item texture was created by user @thewayitwasintended on Discord
